content.title: Peter Alexander is leaving NBC News to join MS NOW as an anchor | The Seattle Times
content.text: Skip Ad Skip to content Skip Ad By Stephen Battaglio Los Angeles Times Peter Alexander, who covered Washington for NBC News for more than a decade, is leaving the network to join MS NOW, according to people familiar with his plans.Alexander, 49, will serve as an anchor and chief national reporter for MS NOW. He will have a weekday program and also handle breaking news coverage throughout the day. Your browser is set to private mode. To continue reading, log in or subscribe.
